analysis.title: US Watch: October PCE inflation tracking: Tracking 0.29% m/m for core PCE after PPI
key_insights: After the PPI release, BofA lowers its October core PCE tracking estimate to 0.29% m/m (3.2% y/y) from 0.32% (3.3%), and headline PCE to 0.30% m/m (3.8% y/y) from 0.34% (3.9%).
The PPI components that feed into PCE were weaker on balance than BofA had assumed before the report, which accounts for the 3bp cut to the core tracking estimate.
BofA says inflation remains too high and momentum has picked up in recent months.
BofA expects the Fed to raise rates by 25bp at each of its next three meetings, taking the terminal rate to 4.5%-4.75%.

macro_indicators.interpretation: BofA's tracking estimate after PPI, down from 0.32% m/m and 3.3% y/y. It is still a firm monthly pace.
